issues.title: review: PR06 independent acceptance — FAIL (invalid statistics isolation)
issues.body:
Independent review of PR #14: **scoped FAIL — PR06-F01 (P2), invalid-statistics isolation**. Normal product checks pass.

A one-field statistics fault injection calls the genuine snapshot then replaces `stages` with `null`. The actual VisionCanvas/engine bridge throws during details rendering and unmounts the camera pipeline (`videoMounted=false`, `pendingRAF=0`). Throwing snapshot computation is correctly contained; malformed returned data is not. **No spontaneous path from valid collector events to this malformed shape was found.** This finding addresses the user's explicit invalid-statistics fault-tolerance requirement, not a claimed normal-use crash.

issues.body:
Independent non-Author review of PR #7's second residual-F01 correction. **Verdict: PASS WITH CONDITIONS. PR04-F01 independently closed; PR04-F02 closure preserved. No new blocking product defect found.**

[Report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/REPORT.md) · [Per-finding closure and conditions](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/findings.json) · [Requirement matrix](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/requirement-test-matrix.md) · [Reproduction](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/REPRODUCE.md) · [Independent native app observations](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/logs/independent-app-observations.json) · [Adapter audit](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/observer-adaptations.md) · [CPU/resource observations](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/logs/pixel-cost.json)

The missing/zero-capability paths now identify actual sampled RGBA bytes and dimensions and send the same private owned canvas to the SDK. Independent real App/Canvas/Engine tests in both rVFC and RAF infer unchanged content once, age measurements correctly, accept changed pixels and changed dimensions (even with the same byte sequence), handle inference/readback failures explicitly and retry without camera/model recreation. A fresh identical native presentation near input expiry does not renew content age. Full SDK-input pixels/dimensions are compared to an independent video reference; canvas source PTS is null.

**Nonblocking conditions:** this fallback intentionally coalesces identical-content frames, so its stalled state describes unchanged content rather than proof of missing camera frame arrivals. Full-image main-thread polling is O(width×height) and expensive: local synthetic equal-content polls averaged about **44 ms at 720p and 94 ms at 1080p**. These are observations, not universal bounds or model/GPU performance. Physical camera/model/GPU/audio, hardware background and cross-platform/deployment behavior remain unverified. Preserve these explicit limits; no new latency budget or Worker migration is imposed. Prior R01 future async lock-wakeup risk remains nonblocking.

Independently replayed PR #9 unit **11/11**, native matrix **6/6**, actual-app **3/3**, forced-delay **6/6**, original native first-frame one per path. New independent pixel boundaries **17/17**, direct-observer native app cases **4/4**, four resolution/resource structural checks pass.

Raw PR #8 abstract fixtures give **8 pass / 21 fail** because they lack readable pixel contexts; that failure is retained. A separately inspected logical positive-quality adapter gives **29/29 unchanged assertions** and is not used as absence-path proof. PR #9 native observers were adapted only to supply the required synthetic Canvas constructor timestamp; assertions and exact changes/hashes are preserved. The new direct observer avoids that timestamp entirely. Initial independent fixture timeouts and one lint error are retained and explained; final meaningful product assertions pass.

The exact reviewed-HEAD [hosted job 120836331099 / run 40081669748](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40081669748/job/120836331099), check-run, SHA checkout and raw logs were independently verified: completed/success, 116 tests, matched Chromium v1248 / 156.0.8078.4, 14 browser passes and seven controls. issues.title: review: PR-04 corrections — F02 closed, F01 compatibility defect remains
issues.body:
Independent non-Author re-review of PR #7's correction checkpoint. **Verdict: FAIL — PR04-F02 closed; PR04-F01 partially addressed and remains open (one medium/P2 blocker).**

The original reproductions now pass unchanged. Immutable VideoFrame identity/ownership and first-frame bootstrap work in the tested paths. A new native capability-absence boundary still violates the no-repeated-frame and input-aging contracts: without VideoFrame or usable playback-quality counters, a running currentTime playhead is mistaken for new images.

**Actual App → VisionCanvas → VisionEngine reproduction:** a single native captureStream(0) frame caused **140 successful SDK calls in 2300 ms**, displayed **60.6 inference FPS**, and kept performance state measuring. Retained actual SDK-input observations have image timestamp 0 and the same red pixels. Immutable and live-quality controls each inferred once. Forced delayed native races reproduce repeated identical input in both rVFC and RAF currentTime-only paths. This is a source-identity/input-aging defect; the collector arithmetic correctly reflects the repeated successful calls.

[Report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/232b2104a2564d96a01e354bf7aeee7a380733f2/docs/verification/pr04-rereview/REPORT.md) · [Per-finding closure and stable findings](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/232b2104a2564d96a01e354bf7aeee7a380733f2/docs/verification/pr04-rereview/findings.json) · [Requirement matrix](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/232b2104a2564d96a01e354bf7aeee7a380733f2/docs/verification/pr04-rereview/requirement-test-matrix.md) · [Reproduction](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/232b2104a2564d96a01e354bf7aeee7a380733f2/docs/verification/pr04-rereview/REPRODUCE.md) · [Actual app observations](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/232b2104a2564d96a01e354bf7aeee7a380733f2/docs/verification/pr04-rereview/logs/app-observations.json) · [Actual app failure log](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/232b2104a2564d96a01e354bf7aeee7a380733f2/docs/verification/pr04-rereview/logs/app-compatibility-aging.txt) · [Source binding](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/232b2104a2564d96a01e354bf7aeee7a380733f2/docs/verification/pr04-rereview/source-bindings.json)

Exact source binding:
- Direct base / reviewed PR #7 HEAD: `fix/inference-scheduler-metrics` at `f81ce6102ec4f459ef7a0c3fb7e55d126b157be5`.
- Reviewed tree, obtained from GitHub: `d15536393c00c55c16c8654612d13d8e7e5692a7`.
- Corrective parent: `89e444820b6befbd333236e65697b5bcf8f5e15a`; actual main base `f1a0d0bbe343b666c75eae053340ceefc6730d5d`.
- New evidence HEAD: `232b2104a2564d96a01e354bf7aeee7a380733f2`, tree `b5d86b085fb679ed618ca73659b97521ac2acf06`.
- 72 added evidence files only, no product changes or deletions. Original FAIL PR #8 and its `c632cf0` HEAD/tree remain unchanged. Separate clean checkout and separate reviewer execution; publication uses the owner's connected GitHub account.

Independent outcomes: clean npm ci, typecheck, lint, **109/109** current unit/component tests, production build, original main **61/61**, **8/8** ordinary browser cases and **7/7** controls pass. Exact original independent vectors **29/29**, original native first-frame **1/1**, original native trials pass. New capture/ownership unit boundaries **11/11** pass. New native still-source matrix **5 pass / 1 fail**, forced-delay matrix **4 pass / 2 fail**, actual-app matrix **2 pass / 1 fail**, all failures supporting residual F01.

The final-head [hosted run 40076315419 / job 120820304359](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40076315419/job/120820304359), check-run, actual SHA checkout and raw logs were independently verified: completed/success, 109 tests, matched Chromium v1248 / 156.0.8078.4, eight browser cases and seven controls. Local tests use explicit system Chromium 154; the known HTTP 403 matched-download denial was not retried or bypassed. Production/e2e/independent SDK artifact isolation passes. Physical camera/model/GPU/audio and device background behavior remain unverified; one optional generated-track collision experiment was inconclusive during source setup and is not a finding.

**Author response required:** correct residual PR04-F01's currentTime-only behavior and input aging, preserve F02 closure, add native capability-absence regressions observing actual SDK input, and return corrected HEAD/tree with full validation and exact-new-HEAD hosted matched Chromium logs for independent re-review. If reliable source identity cannot be supported, use an explicit deliberate unsupported/stopped state; narrowing the compatibility contract requires owner agreement. No Worker migration, merge or deploy is requested.

Publication readback confirms PR #9 is Draft, one evidence-only commit / 72 added files / zero deletions, direct parent f81ce6102ec4f459ef7a0c3fb7e55d126b157be5 and tree b5d86b085fb679ed618ca73659b97521ac2acf06. PR #7 remained at the frozen HEAD at start, before publication and after publication. Original PR #8 and all nine pre-existing branch refs remain unchanged; only the new re-review branch was added. Evidence-directory probes use explicit configs and are not executed by ordinary npm test; a green evidence-PR CI does not close F01.

issues.title: review: independently assess PR-04 — FAIL (duplicate input and missing first frame)
issues.body:
Independent non-Author acceptance review of PR #7 found two blocking contract defects. Verdict: **FAIL**.

- **PR04-F01 (medium, P2):** deferred work reads a newer live image than the recorded arrival identity, then the next callback submits that same image again. Both scheduler paths and the actual canvas/engine bridge fail independent assertions; six native video trials duplicate consumed pixels.
- **PR04-F02 (medium, P2):** rVFC startup does not process an already-presented ready first frame. A native one-frame MediaStream produces zero work in rVFC versus one in the fallback control.

[Report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/c632cf0cbce82b48503540651120c88fff75c8ef/docs/verification/pr04-independent/REPORT.md) · [Stable findings](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/c632cf0cbce82b48503540651120c88fff75c8ef/docs/verification/pr04-independent/findings.json) · [Requirement/test matrix](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/c632cf0cbce82b48503540651120c88fff75c8ef/docs/verification/pr04-independent/requirement-test-matrix.md) · [Reproduction instructions](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/c632cf0cbce82b48503540651120c88fff75c8ef/docs/verification/pr04-independent/REPRODUCE.md) · [Independent failures](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/c632cf0cbce82b48503540651120c88fff75c8ef/docs/verification/pr04-independent/logs/independent-acceptance.txt) · [Source hashes](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/c632cf0cbce82b48503540651120c88fff75c8ef/docs/verification/pr04-independent/source-bindings.json)

Source binding:
- Direct PR base: `fix/inference-scheduler-metrics` at `2f4cdea1bc3e6706f49e37116ede8b1881472f7f`, tree `aaf506b0b70499da4a9474fc39b062841ed06965`.
- Reviewed implementation base main: `f1a0d0bbe343b666c75eae053340ceefc6730d5d`.
- Evidence HEAD: `c632cf0cbce82b48503540651120c88fff75c8ef`, tree `b382360d930ca20a71a5f2e7ae99b764f2250564`.
- Evidence only: 60 new files under `docs/verification/pr04-independent/`; no product fixes, existing test/workflow/history edits, merge or deployment. Separate clean checkout and separate reviewer execution; GitHub publication uses the owner's connected account.

Validation: clean npm ci, typecheck, lint, 86 current tests, production build, original 61-test baseline, four system-Chromium browser tests and seven diagnostic controls pass. **Independent adversarial suite: 25 pass, four assertions fail across 29 cases**, tied to F01/F02. Both native probe commands exit 1 for explicit contract violations. Correct arithmetic, complete processing duration, fault recovery, generations/ownership, bounded retention and production test-hook isolation have positive independent controls.

Matched local Chromium download was blocked by HTTP 403; default local matched-browser runs could not launch. [Exact reviewed-HEAD hosted job 120804489259](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40071091971/job/120804489259) metadata, SHA checkout and actual logs were independently verified: 86 tests, matched Chromium v1248 / 156.0.8078.4, four browser passes and seven controls. Local system-browser results do not replace that binding. Physical camera/model/GPU/audio and hardware background behavior remain unverified.

The reviewer probes are intentionally under the evidence directory with a separate explicit config. Normal CI does not execute them; a green check on this evidence PR does not close the findings.

**Author response required:** address PR04-F01 and PR04-F02 individually with cause, corrective new commits, regression-test links, corrected HEAD/tree, complete validation and successful exact-new-HEAD hosted matched-Chromium logs. Return for independent re-review in the same review thread. Do not merge or deploy. PR04-R01 is a separate nonblocking future async-path risk; no Worker migration is requested.

Publication readback: PR #8 is Draft, one evidence-only commit / 60 added files / zero deletions, direct parent is the reviewed SHA and published tree equals the local staged tree. PR #7 remains at its frozen HEAD; main and all eight pre-existing branch refs remain unchanged. No publication blocker remains; implementation correction and independent re-review are outstanding.

issues.title: review: independently validate PR-01 F01 CSS smoke correction — PASS
issues.body:
Independent non-Author re-review of the F01 / P2 correction in [PR #3](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/pull/3): **PASS**. **F01 is closed at the frozen fix commit.** No new scoped severity finding. This evidence-only Draft PR is directly based on the actual fix branch.

- [REPORT.md](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/fc0e643afef17fdcd7ab888e59e34991b85cd2a7/docs/verification/pr01-f01-independent-review/REPORT.md)
- [findings.json](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/fc0e643afef17fdcd7ab888e59e34991b85cd2a7/docs/verification/pr01-f01-independent-review/findings.json)
- [Independent probes, observations and logs](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/tree/fc0e643afef17fdcd7ab888e59e34991b85cd2a7/docs/verification/pr01-f01-independent-review)

## Source and publication binding

- Base branch: `fix/pr01-css-smoke-validation`
- Frozen reviewed fix / sole parent: `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`
- Fix tree: `027d88998218c98966f95db7bbe1362e6703009c`
- Current main / fix's sole parent: `7b813beeebfa3ded90aacda3d69dab76a5ea991d`
- Review branch: `review/pr01-css-smoke-validation`
- Evidence HEAD: `fc0e643afef17fdcd7ab888e59e34991b85cd2a7`
- Evidence tree: `f8553878e7b41a57a31d6a9b91939e7bfe7a5a10`

Remote commit/tree fetched and verified against the local staged tree. Only the new `docs/verification/pr01-f01-independent-review/` directory differs. No Author branches, historical evidence or product/test/CI source changed. Preflight and prepublication checks found no target movement, submitted review or duplicate CSS re-review.

## Independent results

A separate untouched exact-source detached checkout received clean npm ci, npm ls --all, typecheck, lint, eight unit/component tests, production build, ordinary smoke, Author controls, and ordinary smoke after controls: **all exit 0**. Linux / Node 24.19.0 / npm 11.9.0 / Playwright 1.64.1 / system Chromium 154.0.8037.57.

The independent probe archives/builds original product `f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`, discovers generated CSS without hardcoded hashes, directly measures delivery/CSSOM/applied styles in a real browser, and then runs each source's unchanged ordinary smoke. Original missing-href mutation: **200 text/html, zero rules, margin 8px, no page errors, smoke exit 0**. Same mutation on the correction: **exit 1 at required stylesheet MIME**.

All **15 independent trials** matched expected behavior: original healthy/missing-href; corrected healthy, missing href, deleted CSS, absent local link, empty CSS, invalid CSS with CSS MIME, valid CSS with wrong MIME, nonempty unrelated CSS, separately overridden body/root/header styles, independent fatal JavaScript, and healthy recovery. Negative exits 1 are expected sensitivity results. The original and corrected complete production build manifests match; source and build remain unchanged after probes.

The Author runner's two healthy and five fault outcomes matched. Independent mutations of its child smoke also confirm the runner itself exits 1 if missing CSS unexpectedly passes or if a failure has the wrong diagnostic; cleanup still succeeds. Routes preserve real local app execution, block external resources and deny camera. UI/model/comparison and final fatal-JS checks remain active.

## Hosted CI

Exact-fix [CI run 40050196050](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40050196050), [verify job 120740948261](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40050196050/job/120740948261): **completed/success** on `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`. Independently fetched metadata, exact-commit checks, all steps and downloaded job logs confirm exact checkout, Node 24.19.0/npm 11.17.0, eight tests, matched Chromium/headless shell **v1248 / Chrome 156.0.8078.4**, ordinary smoke and all controls. Logs are accessible and archived.

Evidence-PR [CI run 40051327032](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40051327032), [verify job 120744440331](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40051327032/job/120744440331): **completed/success**, terminal run updated **2026-10-24 01:48:09 UTC**, exact evidence HEAD `fc0e643afef17fdcd7ab888e59e34991b85cd2a7`, tree `f8553878e7b41a57a31d6a9b91939e7bfe7a5a10`. Every job step succeeded, including ordinary smoke and **Stylesheet smoke controls**. The exact-commit check-run API independently agrees.

Downloaded evidence-job logs confirm checkout of that SHA, Node **24.19.0** / npm **11.17.0**, eight unit/component tests, matched Chromium/headless shell **v1248 / Chrome 156.0.8078.4**, one ordinary smoke pass, two intact control passes and all five intended negative child exits 1. The hosted runner and job exited successfully; expected negative children are not failed CI. No local system-browser override was used in hosted CI.

Final Git fetch confirms the evidence branch still points to the stated HEAD/tree with sole parent `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`; the source fix and main refs remain unchanged. Comparing against the fix outside the new evidence directory returns no differences, local source/evidence checkouts are clean, and evidence diff whitespace checks pass. No operation was denied or left with an uncertain outcome. No publication blocker remains.

## Readiness and limits

The reviewed corrected foundation is ready for **separately authorized PR-02/03 work that includes this correction**. Main still points to the uncorrected parent; this review does not integrate the fix. F02 / P3 and F03–F05 / P2 remain unchanged inherited deferrals in their original scope.

Local matched-browser download was attempted and returned HTTP 403 Domain forbidden; local results use system Chromium 154. Hosted matched-browser evidence is distinct. Preliminary reviewer harness/setup errors and complete successful reruns are disclosed in `logs/setup-history.txt`.

Real camera/model/GPU/audio, geometry/tracking/FPS, broad accessibility, Windows/macOS and production deployment are not certified. Keep Draft. No merge, auto-merge, release, deploy, settings change or later-phase implementation.

issues.title: review: PR-01 foundation — PASS WITH CONDITIONS
issues.body:
Independent non-Author review of PR #1: **PASS WITH CONDITIONS**. The clean foundation checks pass, but **F01 (P2)** must be corrected and independently reverified before PR-01 final acceptance or PR-02 start.

The unchanged production smoke passes after its required bundled stylesheet is replaced with a missing URL. Vite returns HTML 200; the stylesheet has zero rules and the app loses its styling. The smoke checks HTTP >=400/request failures and uncaught JavaScript, but misses this case. This PR publishes findings and reproducible isolated probes; it does not repair implementation.

- [REPORT.md](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695/docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/REPORT.md)
- [findings.json](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695/docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/findings.json)
- [Evidence index and reproduction](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695/docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/INDEX.md)

No P0/P1 finding. F02 is the bounded lint-exception blind spot; F03 dictionary, F04 capability/backend truthfulness, and F05 camera lifecycle are inherited, documented deferrals. Full contracts, locations, impact and acceptance conditions are in the register.

## Source and publication binding

- Reviewed source / direct parent: `f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`

Only the new `docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/` directory is added. Existing product source, tests, CI and accepted evidence are preserved. Preflight found no target movement, prior reviews or duplicate review PR.

## Validation

Exact-source clean detached checkout, Node 24.19.0/npm 11.9.0/Linux: npm ci, npm ls --all, typecheck, ESLint, 8 tests, production build and one production smoke all pass; final Git status clean. Baseline esbuild/Vite ERESOLVE was reproduced. Dev/clean/ignore/lock checks pass. Type/lint/service/UI/uncaught-error negative controls fail as expected; required CSS loss unexpectedly passes (F01). Base/target synthetic engine and dictionary outputs match.

Original product [CI run 40047953579](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40047953579), [job 120733858384](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40047953579/job/120733858384): completed/success on exact reviewed source SHA. API metadata and downloaded logs independently confirm checkout, all steps, Node 24.19.0/npm 11.17.0 and matched Chromium v1248 installation/smoke.

Evidence-PR [CI run 40049310581](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40049310581), [job 120738153472](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40049310581/job/120738153472): **completed/success at 2026-10-24 01:20:59 UTC**, exact evidence HEAD `67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695`. Every verification step succeeded. Downloaded logs confirm exact checkout, Node 24.19.0/npm 11.17.0, 8 tests, matched Chromium v1248 installation and one production smoke pass. This is separate from original product CI and does **not** resolve F01; CI does not execute the independent negative-control scripts.

Final remote receipt: the review branch still points to `67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695`, tree `328519ed7bcba68ca303173f5e7bb608c4371365`, with sole parent `f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`. Comparing source and accepted evidence outside the new directory returns no differences.

## Limits and boundaries

Local matched browser download returned HTTP 403; local smoke used system Chromium 154. Hosted original CI installed matched Chrome 156 successfully. Real camera/device/GPU/model inference, accuracy/geometry/FPS, audible/full TTS, broad accessibility, Windows/macOS and deployment/source equivalence remain unverified. Foundation review is not whole-app acceptance.

Keep this review PR Draft. No merge, release, deploy, ruleset/branch-protection change, PR #1 modification or PR-02/03 implementation was performed by this reviewer.

## Post-publication source-state observation

During publication, PR #1 was merged externally at **2026-10-24 01:19:46 UTC**. Main is now `7b813beeebfa3ded90aacda3d69dab76a5ea991d`, whose tree is exactly `85c621486eafb7eb2bdf95189fc89c059ba7dc83`, identical to the frozen reviewed source. The Author branch remains `f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`. This reviewer neither requested nor performed that merge. REPORT.md preserves the review-time snapshot and requested gates. F01 remains unresolved on the merged tree; the condition before PR-02 still applies. The review PR remains directly based on the requested Author branch.

The external merge also triggered main-push [CI run 40049286165](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40049286165), [job 120738075419](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40049286165/job/120738075419): **completed/success** on `7b813beeebfa3ded90aacda3d69dab76a5ea991d`, all steps successful. Remaining implementation condition: F01.
